x-comment: The AAO 0.1 charter of degent.club, the Decentralized Gentlemen Club. Source of truth for
regenerate with `pnpm mesh:emit`, validate with `pnpm mesh:check`. Rules: @bsh/mesh from the
Degent Club is a members' club. The Club is a place; membership is earned by making (an artist
hangs a Degent by the house rules, any member can mint it); the house keeps the rules and the
seal (the rules are code, the seal is the parent inscription co-signed by the policy signer;
nobody holds anyone else's keys or money).
accountableTo is a PLACEHOLDER that validates: it must become a real, named human's address
before this charter is published on degent.club (see deps/scribbit/platform/mesh/README.md).
parent-custody is the only role that signs anything, and it signs one input of one shape
(ADR-0002 section 3, ADR-0005): hence CRITICAL. The growth and revenue families are empty
on purpose; an empty family is honest.
name: degent.club
description: The Decentralized Gentlemen Club: an inscribed members' club on Bitcoin, its Open Studio for artists and its automated, non-custodial mint.

roles.name: parent-custody
roles.purpose: Co-signs the collection parent only for a reveal that returns the parent intact and pays the child to the recorded recipient, and refuses everything else.
roles.measure: Reveals co-signed that violated the parent policy, over reveals co-signed

roles.name: mint-operation
roles.purpose: Moves each paid order from commit to delivered: leases the parent, broadcasts through the lane its weight requires, verifies the content on chain, and offers rescue when anything stalls.
roles.measure: Paid orders delivered or rescuable, over paid orders

roles.name: art-review
roles.purpose: Decides whether a submission is a Degent by the published house rules, with reasons an artist can act on, and hands anything uncertain to a person.
roles.measure: False approvals in the published review corpus

roles.name: pricing
roles.purpose: Quotes every mint exactly: network cost, the club fee and the artist's royalty, fixed at quote time and paid by the minter inside their own funding transaction.
roles.measure: Quotes whose outputs match the funding transaction the minter signed

roles.name: artist-relations
roles.purpose: Answers artists: sign-in, payout proof, review appeals and royalty questions, and tells them when their work is minted.
roles.measure: Artist appeals answered by a person within five business days

x-bitcoin.comment: Blockspace extension, not part of aao 0.1.
x-bitcoin.royalty: 10% of the mint price, an output of the minter's funding transaction (ADR-0007)
